description: raqib-event/1 to ECS as docs/specs/EVENT.md's Mapping names it (siem/README.md): every named key to its ECS field, every other key the spec knows under raqib, the names of the keys it does not know in raqib.unknown_keys, the line in event.original, the arrival in event.ingested; a line that is not an event by these checks is kept with event.kind pipeline_error and its reason in error.message; no field a shipper set is removed, and no document id is set

fail.message: not a raqib-event/1 event: its schema is not raqib-event/1

script.source: boolean typed(def v, String t) { if (t == 's') { return v instanceof String; } if (t == 'i') { return v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Long; } if (t == 'p') { return (v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Long) && v >= 1; } if (t == 'c') { return (v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Long) && v >= 0; } if (t == 'f') { return v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Long || v instanceof Double || v instanceof Float; } if (t == 'b') { return v instanceof Boolean; } if (t == 'o') { return v instanceof Map; } if (t == 'S') { if (!(v instanceof List)) { return false; } for (def x : v) { if (!(x instanceof String)) { return false; } } return true; } return true; } void walk(def v, int depth, List tally) { if (depth > 10) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: deeper than 10 levels'); } if (v instanceof Map) { for (def e : v.entrySet()) { if (e.getKey() == '') { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: an empty key'); } tally.set(0, tally.get(0) + 1); if (tally.get(0) > 200) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: more than 200 keys'); } walk(e.getValue(), depth + 1, tally); } } else if (v instanceof List) { for (def x : v) { walk(x, depth + 1, tally); } } else if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 8000) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: a text longer than 8000 characters'); } } def r = ctx.raqib; def tally = [0]; walk(r, 1, tally); def base = ['schema', 'id', 'n', 'time', 'kind', 'about', 'rev', 'severity', 'watch']; for (def k : base) { if (!r.containsKey(k)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: the base key ' + k + ' is missing'); } } def top = ['schema': 's', 'id': 's', 'n': 'p', 'prev': 's', 'time': 's', 'kind': 's', 'about': 's', 'rev': 'p', 'severity': 's', 'alarm': 'b', 'summary': 's', 'rule': 'o', 'subject': 'o', 'evidence': 'o', 'hole': 'o', 'knocked': 'o', 'state': 's', 'result': 'o', 'counts': 'o', 'watch': 'o']; for (def e : top.entrySet()) { if (r.containsKey(e.getKey()) && !typed(r[e.getKey()], e.getValue())) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: ' + e.getKey() + ' is not of its kind of value'); } } def kinds = ['finding', 'source-finding', 'note', 'tree', 'hole', 'knock', 'heartbeat', 'watch']; if (!kinds.contains(r.kind)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: its kind is not one of the spec\'s eight'); } def wbase = ['run', 'host', 'beat']; for (def k : wbase) { if (!r.watch.containsKey(k)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: the base key watch.' + k + ' is missing'); } } def checked = ['rule': ['id': 's', 'class': 's', 'kind': 's', 'fp_budget': 'f', 'attack': 'S'], 'subject': ['pid': 'c', 'image': 's'], 'watch': ['run': 's', 'mode': 's', 'platform': 's', 'version': 's', 'host': 's', 'beat': 'f']]; for (def p : checked.entrySet()) { def part = r[p.getKey()]; if (part != null) { for (def e : p.getValue().entrySet()) { if (part.containsKey(e.getKey()) && !typed(part[e.getKey()], e.getValue())) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('not an event: ' + p.getKey() + '.' + e.getKey() + ' is not of its kind of value'); } } } }

Map obj(Map m, String k) { if (!(m[k] instanceof Map)) { m[k] = [:]; } return m[k]; } def r = ctx.raqib; def top = ['schema': 's', 'id': 's', 'n': 'p', 'prev': 's', 'time': 's', 'kind': 's', 'about': 's', 'rev': 'p', 'severity': 's', 'alarm': 'b', 'summary': 's', 'rule': 'o', 'subject': 'o', 'evidence': 'o', 'hole': 'o', 'knocked': 'o', 'state': 's', 'result': 'o', 'counts': 'o', 'watch': 'o']; def parts = ['rule': ['id', 'class', 'kind', 'fp_budget', 'attack'], 'subject': ['tree', 'pid', 'image', 'started', 'named', 'agent', 'path', 'benign', 'history', 'by'], 'evidence': ['run', 'round', 'rounds', 'record', 'source', 'trace', 'seqs', 'lines', 'cites', 'cites_left_out', 'same_as'], 'hole': ['kind', 'class', 'count', 'last'], 'knocked': ['status', 'event', 'title', 'limit_id', 'called', 'for'], 'result': ['word', 'exit', 'suppressed'], 'counts': ['rounds', 'findings', 'source_findings', 'holes', 'blind', 'notes', 'trees', 'knocks'], 'watch': ['run', 'mode', 'platform', 'version', 'host', 'beat']]; def unknown = []; for (def k : new ArrayList(r.keySet())) { if (!top.containsKey(k)) { unknown.add(k); r.remove(k); } } for (def p : parts.entrySet()) { def part = r[p.getKey()]; if (part instanceof Map) { for (def k : new ArrayList(part.keySet())) { if (!p.getValue().contains(k)) { unknown.add(p.getKey() + '.' + k); part.remove(k); } } } } if (!unknown.isEmpty()) { Collections.sort(unknown); r.unknown_keys = unknown.size() > 50 ? new ArrayList(unknown.subList(0, 50)) : unknown; } r.remove('time'); def ev = obj(ctx, 'event'); ev.id = r.remove('id'); ev.action = r.remove('kind'); def sev = ['high': 4, 'medium': 3, 'low': 2, 'info': 1, 'hole': 3]; if (sev.containsKey(r.severity)) { ev.severity = sev[r.remove('severity')]; } ev.kind = r.remove('alarm') == true ? 'alert' : 'event'; if (r.containsKey('summary')) { ctx.message = r.remove('summary'); } else { ctx.remove('message'); } def w = r.watch; def h = obj(ctx, 'host'); h.name = w.remove('host'); def ob = obj(ctx, 'observer'); ob.product = 'Raqib'; if (w.containsKey('version')) { ob.version = w.remove('version'); } if (w.isEmpty()) { r.remove('watch'); } def ru = r.rule; if (ru != null) { if (ru.containsKey('id')) { def rr = obj(ctx, 'rule'); rr.id = ru.remove('id'); } if (ru.containsKey('class')) { def rc = obj(ctx, 'rule'); rc.category = ru.remove('class'); } if (ru.containsKey('attack')) { def te = obj(obj(ctx, 'threat'), 'technique'); te.id = ru.remove('attack'); } if (ru.isEmpty()) { r.remove('rule'); } } def su = r.subject; if (su != null) { if (su.containsKey('pid')) { def pp = obj(ctx, 'process'); pp.pid = su.remove('pid'); } if (su.containsKey('image')) { def pn = obj(ctx, 'process'); pn.name = su.remove('image'); } if (su.isEmpty()) { r.remove('subject'); } }
